name: 71203 · Monroe, LA
findings: ZIP 71203 (Monroe) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71203 (Monroe) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
